judge.label: LLM rubric score, fresh-context judge, self-assessed — not human QA.
judge.independence_caveat: This judge is a different model family and a fresh context: it saw only the judge prompt, the rubric and the lesson. It did not direct the project and did not author anything in it. It is still a language model scoring a language model's output, so the label applies: not human QA.

notes.bilingual_quality: The lesson declares bilingual: true, but all Arabic content fields (mdAr, textAr, termAr, defAr, etc.) contain English text identical to the English fields. There is no Arabic translation present.

verdict_notes: The instructional design is strong across all criteria, with a particularly effective worked example and scenario. However, the lesson fails the bilingual quality criterion entirely because it declares itself bilingual yet provides no Arabic translation, rendering the Arabic fields as English placeholders.
